register.labelZh: BRING 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: bring along、bring back、bring in、bring down、bring up 和 bring over 等表達,可以描述帶同人物或物件、把它們帶回,或移到另一個地方。；bring together 可以令人團結;bring somebody round 可以表示說服某人;bring somebody out 可以令人更有自信;bring somebody on 則可以表示協助學習者或球員進步。；bring about、bring on、bring forth 和 bring something upon somebody 可以說明改變、疾病、反應或不愉快結果是如何出現的。；你可以用 bring in 表示引入規則、bring forward 表示把日期提前、bring down 表示降低價格、bring in 表示帶來收入,以及 bring off 表示成功完成困難的計劃。
register.summaryEn: Expressions such as bring along, bring back, bring in, bring down, bring up and bring over let you describe taking people and things with you, returning them, or moving them to another place. Bring together can unite people, bring somebody round can change a person's mind, bring somebody out can build confidence, and bring somebody on can help a learner or player improve. Bring about, bring on, bring forth and bring something upon somebody help you explain how a change, illness, response or unpleasant result happened. You can bring in a rule, bring a date forward, bring prices down, bring money in or bring off a difficult plan.

benefits.titleZh: 用 BRING 描述不同方向的移動
benefits.titleEn: Use BRING to describe movement in many directions
benefits.zh: bring along、bring back、bring in、bring down、bring up 和 bring over 等表達,可以描述帶同人物或物件、把它們帶回,或移到另一個地方。
benefits.en: Expressions such as bring along, bring back, bring in, bring down, bring up and bring over let you describe taking people and things with you, returning them, or moving them to another place.

benefits.titleZh: 談論人際關係、自信和個人成長
benefits.titleEn: Talk about relationships, confidence and personal development
benefits.zh: bring together 可以令人團結;bring somebody round 可以表示說服某人;bring somebody out 可以令人更有自信;bring somebody on 則可以表示協助學習者或球員進步。
benefits.en: Bring together can unite people, bring somebody round can change a person's mind, bring somebody out can build confidence, and bring somebody on can help a learner or player improve.

benefits.zh: bring about、bring on、bring forth 和 bring something upon somebody 可以說明改變、疾病、反應或不愉快結果是如何出現的。
benefits.en: Bring about, bring on, bring forth and bring something upon somebody help you explain how a change, illness, response or unpleasant result happened.

benefits.titleZh: 描述工作和日常生活中的實際改動
benefits.titleEn: Describe practical changes in work and daily life
benefits.zh: 你可以用 bring in 表示引入規則、bring forward 表示把日期提前、bring down 表示降低價格、bring in 表示帶來收入,以及 bring off 表示成功完成困難的計劃。
benefits.en: You can bring in a rule, bring a date forward, bring prices down, bring money in or bring off a difficult plan.
